review_summary: Round 3 has enough large-value separation to start structural landmarks. The face is still blocky, so first connect the skin planes with a deliberately chosen mixer pass, then place only the eyes, nose, mouth, ear and pearl. No general detail pass yet.

actions.intent: connect the blocky skin passages before drawing features
actions.decision: The skin is visibly split into horizontal capsules. This is a real edge-continuity problem, so Mixer is justified here; it is not being inserted by cadence.

actions.intent: place the ear as a subdued warm shape between face and dark neck
actions.decision: The ear is a small warm mass at the back of the head and is necessary to anchor the pearl; keep it broad and quiet.

actions.intent: establish both eye axes and gaze with the minimum dark marks
actions.decision: The eyes are the highest-value structural landmarks now. Place only upper-lid/gaze marks; do not render lashes or iris texture.

actions.intent: fix gaze direction with two tiny dark accents
actions.decision: The reference gaze points left toward the viewer. Two tiny dark marks are enough; stop there and review before any highlight.

actions.intent: define the nose with one shadow-side axis rather than an outlined triangle
actions.decision: The nose is a long softly modeled wedge. A single broken shadow-side line is enough to establish its direction at this stage.

actions.intent: keep the nose readable as volume by adding one restrained light-side stroke
actions.decision: The nose needs a light counterpart to the shadow axis, but not a bright outline.

actions.intent: set mouth width, tilt and opening with two red-brown marks
actions.decision: The mouth is small and slightly parted. Establish its axis and lower lip volume without tracing the entire contour.

actions.intent: place the pearl as a distinct hanging object before its highlight
actions.decision: The pearl is a critical focal landmark and should already be visibly larger than a point. Build a cool gray base with a few strokes only.

actions.intent: give the pearl one strong light accent
actions.decision: One pale highlight should be enough to separate the pearl from the neck; do not add a ring of white marks.
